extracted.name: Sweet Sesame Slaw
extracted.description: This quick, easy slaw recipe is a terrific combo of cabbage, carrot, and jicama mixed with a tasty, creamy Asian-inspired dressing with sesame seeds.
instruction_lines: Place cabbage, carrot, jicama, and sesame seeds in a large bowl.
Whisk together mayonnaise, vinegar, sesame oil, and honey in a small bowl.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad; toss until evenly coated. Chill at least 4 hours before serving.
